TotheMaxConstruction did a fantastic job on my project. Max Garcia, owner, responded within hours of my initial call and during the remodel. I had a second story leak from the master bathroom.which also damaged the kitchen. Also, I didn't need to hire an interior designer because Max was able to recommend all the right materials and colors. He works with you to understand your individual goals and cares about the quality of their work. I absolutely love my new master bath, kitchen and hearthroom. Max and his crew were a pleasure to work with. There are plenty of reasons why they have a five star rating! Thanks Max!
